svg.aria-label: Animated explainer in five slides. 1. Many AI agents share one memory. 2. A tech fact that is wrong breaks loudly: a note says save reports in the Reports folder, the agent gets an error that the folder is not found, flags the note and fixes it to the Shared folder. 3. A business fact that is wrong breaks quietly: refunds up to USD 50 are automatic, agents see no error, but the real limit is now USD 25. 4. After a while BAB asks a person: is this still true? The person says No, an agent finds the new rule, USD 25, and the person approves it. 5. One agent can be wrong. The memory gets fixed. Agents fix what breaks. People check what can't break.
svg.title: How BAB catches and fixes a wrong memory

g.text: Many AI agents share one memory.
What one agent learns, every agent can use.
A tech fact that is wrong breaks loudly.
The agent that hits the error flags the note and fixes it.
A business fact that is wrong breaks quietly.
Refunds up to USD 50 are automatic.
But the real limit is now USD 25. Nothing fails.
Time since a person last checked it
After a while, BAB asks a person.
Refunds up to USD 50 are automatic.
Agent: I found the new rule. Save it?
Refunds up to USD 25 are automatic.
Refunds up to USD 25 are automatic.
The person says No, checks the new rule, and approves it.
One agent can be wrong. The memory gets fixed.
Agents fix what breaks. People check what can't break.
BAB: shared memory for AI agents.
